description: Test registration endpoint with valid unique email, password, name, and org_name. Verify response returns 200 OK with token, user data, and organization data.
passCriteria: Response contains 'token' field with JWT token (length > 100)
Response contains 'user' object with user_id, email, name
Response contains 'organization' object with org_id, name
Email in response matches input email
Token is a valid JWT format
failureIndicators: HTTP status is not 200 (e.g., 400 'Email already registered', 500 server error)
Email mismatch between input and response
